description: This source file contains translation prompt templates for a translation function, including language-specific templates for Chinese and Japanese, and a helper function to build glossary prompts.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Converts language code to human-readable label, with special handling for common language codes.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Generates a translation prompt string based on source and target languages, using appropriate templates.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a glossary section for prompts from a list of glossary entries.
